## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Saññojanasampayuttaduka* is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* division of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As part of the *Duka-paṭṭhāna* matrices, it investigates conditional causal relations (*paccaya*) structured around the Abhidhamma dyad (*duka*) of phenomena associated with the fetters (*saññojanasampayutta*) and those dissociated from them [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].

Computational text-reuse data from DharmaNexus identifies 289 internal Pali matches across 45 texts in the canon, demonstrating extensive formulaic and structural sharing within the Abhidhamma literature [DharmaNexus]. Its most extensive reuse occurs with related fetter-analysis sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, particularly the *Saññojanagocchaka* (Patthana 2.4, sharing 82 matching passages), the *Saññojanagocchaka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.5), the *Upādānagocchaka* (Patthana 2.11), and the *Nīvaraṇagocchaka* (Patthana 2.8) [DharmaNexus]. It also exhibits high degrees of segment overlap with parallel dyadic treatments of mental association across other defilement categories, such as the *Āsavasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.16 and Patthana 14.15), the *Saññojanasaññojanasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.24), and the *Ganthasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.28) [DharmaNexus]. Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus reports any cross-language parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
